title: Widow of Kidapawan radioman welcomes guilty verdict for killers
summary: COTABATO CITY – The widow of slain Kidapawan radio journalist Eduardo “Ed” Dizon lauded a Quezon City court for the guilty verdict rendered on Tuesday against two men accused of murdering him…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The widow of slain Kidapawan radio journalist Eduardo “Ed” Dizon lauded a Quezon City court for the guilty verdict rendered on Tuesday against two men accused of murdering him in 2019. “Justice is served. I thank all friends of Ed Dizon, thank you for your prayers, and to DXND people,” Madonna Dizon, wife of the murdered journalist, said. Dizon had worked for the Church-run DXND Radio Bida in Kidapawan City.
